The AP Voter Poll / AP-NORC 2026 Midterm Voter Survey
Washington Post-Ipsos 2026 National Polls (White House East Wing Ballroom & D.C. Projects)
The Guardian / Harris Poll & KFF 2026 Pre-Election Voter Surveys

trump_overall_approval_pct.source: AP Voter Poll (35% approve / ~60% disapprove); Network Exit Polls (~38% approve / ~60% disapprove)

issue_breaking_points_convergence.question_summary: Trump administration tariffs hurt vs. helped the U.S. economy
issue_breaking_points_convergence.salience_notes: 39%-40% named the economy/cost of living the #1 issue; ~50% called high prices a 'crucial' voting factor.
primary_exposed_cohorts: Plains & Midwest Rural Farm Belt (IA, KS, NE, ND, SD, OH)
issue_breaking_points_convergence.source: NBC News / CBS News 2026 Exit Polls (65%-66% hurt economy)

issue_breaking_points_convergence.question_summary: U.S. military action against Iran was the wrong decision
issue_breaking_points_convergence.salience_notes: Spiked global oil, domestic gasoline, and agricultural diesel prices; alienated anti-interventionist working-class and young voters.
primary_exposed_cohorts: Young Voters (Under 30: 70% Dem / 30% GOP in House)
issue_breaking_points_convergence.source: NBC News / CBS News / AP Voter Poll 2026 (60%-63% wrong decision; 74% crucial/major factor)

issue_breaking_points_convergence.question_summary: Trump administration immigration enforcement and deportation efforts went too far
issue_breaking_points_convergence.gop_abstract_issue_trust_edge: 44% GOP vs. 41% DEM on abstract immigration handling, but only ~10% of voters named immigration their #1 issue
issue_breaking_points_convergence.salience_notes: Triggered a historic snapback in Hispanic and immigrant-heavy communities that had swung toward Trump in 2024.
issue_breaking_points_convergence.source: CBS News / Network 2026 Exit Polls (57%-60% went too far)

issue_breaking_points_convergence.issue_label: White House East Wing Ballroom & D.C. Vanity Projects
issue_breaking_points_convergence.question_summary: Oppose demolishing the White House East Wing for a 90,000-sq-ft ballroom / Dissatisfied with D.C. remodeling projects
issue_breaking_points_convergence.salience_notes: 97% of public comments opposed; became a visceral symbol of elite self-dealing and misplaced priorities during an affordability crisis.

issue_breaking_points_convergence.issue_label: Government Corruption, Donor Self-Dealing & Checks on Power
issue_breaking_points_convergence.question_summary: Government corruption as a crucial or major factor in 2026 congressional vote
issue_breaking_points_convergence.salience_notes: Encompassed crypto/business conflicts, billionaire donor influence, federal agency hollowing, and executive overreach.
issue_breaking_points_convergence.source: AP Voter Poll / Guardian-Harris / Network Exit Polls 2026

issue_breaking_points_convergence.issue_label: Healthcare Costs & Local AI/Data-Center Infrastructure Backlash
issue_breaking_points_convergence.question_summary: Very concerned about healthcare costs (60%); AI & data center expansion a crucial/major factor (56%)
primary_exposed_cohorts: Exurban & Rural Data-Center Corridor Counties (VA, GA, PA, OH, AZ)
issue_breaking_points_convergence.source: KFF 2026 Voter Poll & Time / Network Exit Polls
